tagline: Prologis is the global leader in logistics real estate.
hero_kpi_rationale: Real estate segment operating profit is the primary driver of Prologis' performance, reflecting the rental value and management of its vast global logistics portfolio.

kpis.name: Real Estate Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from property leasing and development activities, before general and administrative expenses and depreciation.
kpis.description: Real estate segment NOI is a key measure of Prologis' operational performance, representing rental revenues less direct operating expenses.
kpis.signal: Strong rental revenue growth driven by higher rental rates.

kpis.name: Rental Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated from leasing logistics properties.
kpis.description: Represents gross revenues from leasing logistics spaces owned by Prologis.
kpis.signal: Increase in rental revenues due to higher occupancy and rental rates.

kpis.name: Strategic Capital Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profit from asset management services and co-investment activities.
kpis.description: This segment includes revenues from asset management, transaction services, and co-investments with partners.
kpis.signal: Decline in asset management and co-investment revenues.

kpis.name: Total Estimated Investment in Development Starts
kpis.explanation: Total estimated investment in newly launched development projects.
kpis.description: Indicates the scale of new construction projects that Prologis has begun to develop.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in investment in new developments.

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total rentable space currently leased.
kpis.description: Measures the proportion of usable space that is actually leased to tenants.
kpis.signal: High occupancy rate indicating strong demand.

kpis.name: Rent Change on Leases Commenced
kpis.explanation: Percentage increase in rental rates on new leases compared to previous ones.
kpis.description: Indicates Prologis' ability to increase rents upon lease renewal or new lease signings.
kpis.signal: Significant rent increases on new contracts.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.explanation: Total amount of borrowings undertaken by the company.
kpis.description: Represents all financial obligations to be repaid by Prologis.
kpis.signal: High level of debt but with long-term maturities.

kpis.name: Weighted Average Term of Debt
kpis.explanation: Average time to maturity of total debt.
kpis.description: Indicates refinancing risk management by spreading debt maturities over a long period.
kpis.signal: Prudent interest rate risk management with long maturities.

kpis.name: Effective Interest Rate on Debt
kpis.explanation: Average cost of the company's debt.
kpis.description: Represents the average cost of debt, influencing the company's net profitability.

kpis.name: Build-to-Suit Percentage of Development Starts
kpis.explanation: Percentage of new developments designed specifically for a tenant.
kpis.description: Indicates a focus on customized projects to meet specific client needs, reducing leasing risk.
kpis.signal: Strong preference for build-to-suit projects, signaling specific client demand.

kpis.name: Development Margins
kpis.explanation: Estimated profit margin on development projects.
kpis.description: Development margin reflects the expected profitability of real estate projects developed by Prologis.

kpis.name: Contribution to Co-Investment Ventures
kpis.explanation: Value of properties transferred to co-investment vehicles.
kpis.description: Shows the use of co-investment structures to fund growth and realize gains on developed assets.
kpis.signal: Use of co-investments to monetize developed assets.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk on Foreign Currencies
risks.score_rationale: Risk is discussed in detail in Item 1A and Notes 14 and 2, with moderate cautionary language (e.g., 'possibility that our results may differ from expectations'). Potential impact is quantified at $140M for a 10% variation, which is significant. The company uses hedges but remains exposed to cash payments. Macro category weighted heavily in international real estate.

risks.title: Variable Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk is mentioned in Item 1A and detailed in the debt repayment schedule. Language is measured ('possible fluctuations'). Exposure is limited to $1.1Bn of variable debt, representing 3% of total debt. A 10% rate increase would cost an additional $4M annually. Capital category with medium weight.

risks.title: Dependence on Unhedged Derivatives
risks.score_rationale: Foreign exchange contracts not designated as hedges are explicitly mentioned (Note 14). Their impact is recognized in earnings, creating profit volatility. A 10% variation would result in a $140M payment. Language indicates active risk ('gain or loss included in results'). Capital category, high severity.

risks.title: Exposure to International Operations
risks.score_rationale: Risk is categorized under 'Risks Related to our Global Operations'. 7.9% of revenues derive from foreign currencies. While partially hedged, exposure to regulations, local policies, and economic stability is implicit. Language is cautious but recurring. Geopolitical category, high severity in global logistics real estate.

risks.title: Insufficient Hedge Coverage on Foreign Exchange
risks.score_rationale: The company acknowledges that sensitivity analysis has 'limited predictive value' and that actual gains and results will depend on future conditions. This indicates uncertainty about hedge strategy effectiveness. Language is cautious but not alarmist. Capital category, moderate severity.

ai_positioning.summary: Prologis operates in the logistics real estate sector and has no direct involvement in the development or use of AI technologies mentioned in the provided excerpts.
